title: test(kanban): pin the member shape of object-kanban columns and dataSource (objectui#8071 slice 16)
body:
Refs #8071

objectui#8071 **slice 16** — the last two `object-kanban` keys leave
`MEMBER_PIN_EXEMPTIONS` as registered per-block member pins. **The block is
closed outright: zero leftovers.**

`Clause-②: no`

## The ledger, re-derived on this head (⛔ not inherited)

The dispatch's orientation table came from a line-anchored grep and said so.
Re-derived here with a TypeScript **AST walk** — `ts.createSourceFile` →
`VariableDeclaration` → initializer unwrapped through `as` / `satisfies` /
parens → `PropertyAssignment`, object boundaries from **AST node spans**, depth
0 only — because three regex misreadings and one dead brace-depth scan of this
one file are already on the record.

| quantity | before (`c1f039a67a`) | after (`ea0dfd41ae`) |
|---|---|---|
| `MEMBER_PIN_EXEMPTIONS` | 10 | **8** |
| `MEMBER_PINS` | 81 | **83** |
| `MEMBER_PIN_EXEMPTION_CEILING` | 10 | **8** |
| `NEWLY_JUDGED_UNPINNED_MEMBERS` | 2 | **0** |

The instrument's depth-0 **non-property** bucket read `[]` on every record, both
times. **Set identity, both directions and computed rather than asserted:** the
set leaving exemptions equals the set entering pins
(`object-kanban.columns`, `object-kanban.dataSource`); nothing entered
exemptions and nothing left pins.

Remaining **8**: `object-grid` 4 · `object-master-detail-form` 3 ·
`record:related_list.actions` 1.

## ⭐ The objectui#8176 ceiling correction is now SPENT

`NEWLY_JUDGED_UNPINNED_MEMBERS` is the named audit of the one **raise** this
file's ratchet has ever had. All four declarations it admitted are now judged by
a pin. The array is empty and **deliberately kept**: its check has two
directions and only the first empties out — the second, *every exemption on a
block objectui#8176 newly judged must be one of the named four*, now reads **no
lazily registered block may carry a member-pin exemption at all**. That is the
strongest state this list has ever asserted.

## Two inherited readings re-derived, not taken on trust

- **「`object-grid` 余下四个各自成片」 (slice 12's reading, which slices 14 and
  15 each declared un-re-verified).** Re-derived on this head, and it comes out
  **TRUE, with one qualification the inherited sentence does not carry.** The
  four keys' read paths are separable — each can be pinned without any other
  being pinned first — and each carries its own substantial surface in a
  5451-line renderer: `schema.columns` 7 read sites, `schema.filter` 3,
  `schema.grouping` 10 (plus its own module `useGroupedData.ts`), `schema.sort`
  4. **The qualification:** `grouping` and `columns` are *not* disjoint — they
  share the derivation memo that builds grouping columns out of `schema.columns`
  — so whoever pins `grouping` reads `columns` too. ⛔ I did not take that block
  for a second reason, below.
- **objectui#8913, the "unruled contract question" that held `object-kanban`
  back at slice 6.** It is **CLOSED and RULED**, landed as PR objectui#8989:
  `columns` is declared on both faces as the protocol's union
  (`string[] | Lane[]`). ⇒ there is no pending ruling a pin here could be
  deleted by. The other ground, a file-surface collision with PR objectui#8865,
  is stale — that PR is long gone. Both grounds measured, ⛔ neither inherited.

## ⚠️ A serial constraint the dispatch does not carry

The dispatch's off-limits list was enumerated before **PR objectui#9896**, which
holds `packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` — the read site every
`object-grid` ablation would have to mutate. Re-enumerated here across all 21
non-release open pull requests (615 file rows; `packages/plugin-kanban/` returns
one row, `package.json` on PR objectui#8941, and
`apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` returns zero).
⇒ `packages/plugin-kanban/src/**` is uncontested and `object-grid` is not.

## The pins

### `object-kanban.columns` — NEW file, and ⛔ deliberately not a promotion

`packages/plugin-kanban/src/__tests__/objectKanbanColumnMembers-8071.test.tsx`.

objectui#8989 already landed
`packages/types/src/__tests__/object-kanban-columns-declared-8913.test.ts`, read
here **end to end** before being cited. It is a good declaration pin — every
refusal paired with the same lane bag under an undeclared key, so each row
reports its own removal. ⛔ It cannot be credited as the member pin: **every
assertion in it is a `safeParse`**, and objectui#8068's criterion is the shape
the renderer **READS**.

Six members, six sinks, through the real renderer on a real adapter:

- **`id`** — the bucketing key and the heading id, with an unmatched record
  swept into the trailing lane (objectui#2792) as the control.
- ⭐ **`title` is read TWICE.** As presentation it is the lane's accessible name;
  as a **bucketing alias** it is lowercased into `labelToColumnId`, so a record
  whose stored group value is the lane's **TITLE** lands in that lane as surely
  as one carrying its `id`. ⛔ Nothing on the authoring surface says so — which
  means **renaming a lane moves records between lanes**. Controlled by a third
  record matching neither, which *is* an orphan.
- ⭐ **`cards` is a UNION, not a replacement.** Static lane cards survive the
  fetch, come first, and are not de-duplicated against it.
- **`limit`** shows and flags, and ⛔ never truncates — the over-limit row
  asserts *every* card still renders, so a pin watching only the `Full` badge
  could not stay green under a renderer that dropped the overflow.
- **`className`** reaches that lane's container and no other.
- **`collapsed`** withholds that lane's cards — the member-set row only;
  `columnCollapsedHonoured-9628.test.tsx` owns that member whole.
- **The set as a WHITELIST** — an undeclared lane member reaches no sink, with a
  `className` marker on the same lane in the same render as the lit control.

⛔ Not re-asserted here, because each already owns its question:
`laneLessBoard-8990`, `laneIdCoercion-8993`, `laneCountHonesty-8307`,
`columnCollapsedHonoured-9628`.

### `object-kanban.dataSource` — pre-existing file, read end to end, then GROWN

`packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.elementDataSource.test.tsx`.

The key is **injected** by `Registry.register` (`ELEMENT_DATA_SOURCE_INPUT`), so
the declaration says `type: 'object'` and nothing about members: the read site
is the whole member contract, and here it is one line of this package —
`OBJECT_KANBAN_DATA_SOURCE = { filter: true, limit: 'limit' }`.

The three existing describes cover `object`, `view` and the deliberate
non-mapping of `columns`. The five members are **not alike**, so the added block
states each one's disposition:

| member | disposition on this block |
|---|---|
| `object` | mapped, and it **OUTRANKS** an authored `objectName` |
| `view` | the baseline the others are contested against |
| `filter` | **ADDITIONAL** — AND-combined with the board's OWN filter |
| `limit` | mapped onto the block's `limit`; binding > block > view |
| `sort` | ⛔ **NOT mapped** — the board has no `$orderby` read site |

⭐ The inert member is the loudest row. `sort` is a member the spec's binding
declares and this block silently ignores; without a row saying so, a later
contributor "completing the mapping" would wire it onto a key nothing reads and
the pin would stay green. It is asserted with a mapped `limit` moving in the
**same binding** as the lit control, so the two negatives are about `sort` and
not about a binding that never arrived.

⚠️ The combined-filter shape is **measured, not predicted**: each source keeps
its own rule-list nesting under the `and`
(`['and', [['owner','=','me']], [['rating','=','hot']]]`). My first spelling
asserted the flattened form and went red; the row now pins what this repo
actually produces, and the reason is written beside it.

## Ablations

Every leg: mutate → **prove the mutation on disk before reading any result**
(anchor `grep -c` on both the injected and the removed text, plus a
`git hash-object` differing from the HEAD blob) → read the result → restore with
`git checkout HEAD -- <absolute path>` from a `trap … EXIT INT TERM` → prove
restoration **by blob hash and by an empty `git diff HEAD`**, ⛔ never by an exit
code. Run from committed state so the restore leg has a real `HEAD`.

**The gate mechanism** (leg G): one deleted exemption re-added without touching
the ceiling.

**Per new pin**, each shown non-vacuous and failing for **its own** reason with
its neighbours observed green in the same run.

The numbers are in the report on objectui#8071.

## Scope

⛔ Nothing outside this slice was touched. In particular:

- ⛔ **No existing pin was weakened, softened or deleted.**
  objectui#9884 and objectui#9886 are filed and ungraded, and their repairs are
  expected to red pins slice 15 just landed — **by design, and not by my hand.**
  Fix and pin land in the same change, and that change is those cards'.
- ⛔ `record:related_list.actions` keeps `NO_READ_SITE_TO_PIN` and was not
  re-measured — slice 7's measurement still stands. ⛔ Not converted by
  inventing a read site.
- ⛔ `packages/plugin-form/src/masterDetailFormTypeVocabulary.test.tsx` carries
  six cross-file `ObjectForm.tsx:NNNN` citations (AGENTS.md **#11**). The
  standing instruction is *repair opportunistically, never as a sweep* — **my
  diff does not touch that file**, and I did not take the
  `object-master-detail-form` block, so the successor role slice 15 assigned to
  this slice does not transfer. Reported, left alone.

## Acceptance notes

- `object-grid`'s four are separable **and** `grouping`/`columns` share one
  derivation memo. Both halves belong in whatever slice takes them.
- `AWAITING_A_PIN_NEWLY_JUDGED` stays referenced by the audit's loop body even
  with the array empty, so no constant went dead.
